description: Get the ranked trending topics of any country or city on X, or list every place X publishes trends for. No login, cookies or API key needed.

allLocations.description: Collect trends for every place X serves (currently 467 countries and cities, up to 50 trends each). When enabled, the Locations list is ignored.
allLocations.title: All available locations

dedupeAcrossLocations.description: When the same trend appears in several requested locations, keep one row with all locations and the best rank instead of one row per location.
dedupeAcrossLocations.title: Merge repeated trends across locations

excludeHashtags.description: Skip trends that start with #. X applies this filter before returning the list.
excludeHashtags.title: Exclude hashtags

includeSearchUrls.description: Include a ready-made X search link for every trend.
includeSearchUrls.title: Include search links

locations.description: Countries, cities, country codes, slugs or WOEIDs (mode=trends). Examples: Worldwide, United States, US, United Kingdom, GB, London, Tokyo, sao-paulo, 23424977. Put "all" to collect every location. Add a country after a comma when two places share a name, for example "Barcelona, ES".
locations.title: Locations

maxTrendsPerLocation.description: How many ranked trends to keep for each location. X publishes up to 50.
maxTrendsPerLocation.title: Maximum trends per location

mode.description: Choose whether to collect the current trends or list the places X publishes trends for.
mode.title: Mode

placeTypeFilter.description: Limit the location list to countries, cities and towns, the worldwide entry, or X's unknown place type.
placeTypeFilter.title: Place type (mode=locations)

proxyConfiguration.description: Optional. Use a proxy if you plan very large or repeated runs.
proxyConfiguration.sectionDescription: Optional settings for large or repeated runs.
proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration

trendNameContains.description: Optional case-insensitive keyword filter. A trend is kept when its name contains at least one of these words. Useful for brand or topic monitoring.
trendNameContains.title: Only trends containing these words

title: X Trends by Location
